observations.code_quote: The new dashboard shows the conversion-goal suggestions from Setup, including missing New user and Revenue classifications. Review in Setup opens the existing configuration flow. Dismissed suggestions remain recoverable in Setup, and collapsing the dashboard suggestions persists in local storage. This does not create goals automatically or change candidate ranking.
